capabilities: Open a homepage note when a folder title is clicked in the file explorer
Detect homepage files by a priority list of filenames or a folder-name match
Auto-create a homepage note if none exists
Configure which filenames count as homepages
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian folders are not clickable notes, so viewing a folder's overview requires manually searching for and opening its index or readme file.
summary: Folder navigation plugin that opens a homepage note (e.g. README.md) whenever a folder title is clicked in the file explorer.
